class.name: HEGoGraphInput3D
class.brief_description: A 3D graph of points and connections that can be fed into a [HEGoNode3D] input.
class.description: Add a [HEGoGraphAttributes] child to declare the attributes each point and connection can carry. Positions are stored in local space. Connections are undirected unique pairs; a point with three or more connections is an intersection.

method.name: connection_count
method.description: Number of connections, i.e. half of [member connections].

method.name: get_connection
method.description: The two point indices of connection [param index], smaller first.

method.name: add_point
method.description: Appends a point at [param position] and returns its index.

method.name: remove_points
method.description: Deletes the given point indices and any connection that used them. Remaining connection indices are remapped.

method.name: add_connection
method.description: Adds an undirected connection between [param a] and [param b]. Returns the new connection index, or [code]-1[/code] if the pair is invalid or already present.

method.name: has_connection
method.description: Whether an undirected connection between [param a] and [param b] already exists.

method.name: remove_connections
method.description: Deletes the given connection indices. Points are left in place.

method.name: split_connection
method.description: Inserts a point at [param position] on connection [param conn_index], replacing that connection with two that inherit its attributes. Returns the new point index, or [code]-1[/code] if the connection does not exist.

method.name: set_point_attrib_on
method.description: Sets attribute [param name] on each of [param indices] to [param value].

method.name: set_connection_attrib_on
method.description: Sets attribute [param name] on each of [param indices] to [param value].

method.name: sync_schema
method.description: Rebuilds stored attribute arrays from [HEGoGraphAttributes] children: adds missing keys at their defaults, drops keys that are no longer defined, and resizes to the current point and connection counts.

method.name: collect_schema
method.description: Attribute definitions from every [HEGoGraphAttributes] child, in tree order. Reserved and duplicate names are skipped with a warning.

method.name: is_reserved_name
method.description: Whether [param name] is reserved for Houdini or HEGo metadata.

method.name: capture_state
method.description: A copy of the topology and attribute arrays, for undo.

method.name: apply_state
method.description: Restores a state produced by [method capture_state].

members.member: Point positions, in this node's local space.
Connection endpoints as index pairs [code][a0, b0, a1, b1, ...][/code]. Each pair is stored with the smaller index first.
Per-point attribute values, keyed by name. Each value is a packed array the same length as [member points].
Per-connection attribute values, keyed by name. Each value is a packed array the same length as [method connection_count].

signal.name: graph_changed
signal.description: The graph's topology or attribute values changed.

constants.constant: Category this file logs under, shown in the session panel filter.
Names that already mean something on Houdini input geometry.
Prefix reserved for HEGo's own metadata attributes.
